projects.name: My projects
projects.blurb: The portfolio behind projects.navonsimon.com: every project, its story and how to reach it, kept in step with this ledger.

projects.name: Mellow
projects.blurb: A personal listening room: six generative ambient scenes that never repeat, plus AI-generated focus soundscapes (rain study, café hush, brown noise) with 25/50/90-minute sessions. It follows the volume keys on the Mac through a small helper and shows a macOS-style HUD, and it installs as an offline app. Runs as its own Cloudflare Worker.

projects.name: SETA
projects.blurb: SETA is a Hebrew website for Romanian human hair sold to salons in Israel: a product catalog, a media gallery and one-click photo and video uploads. Editors work in integration; the owner reviews and publishes to production, with persistent storage and rollback on my Kubernetes cluster.

projects.name: Shorts Studio
projects.blurb: Turns a voice memo into a finished short video. An AI writes a real story arc, generates pictures with a consistent main character, narrates it in my own cloned voice, then renders it with transitions, captions and music. It has a hard monthly spend limit.

projects.name: Video and Image Generation Skills
projects.blurb: A showcase of twelve AI video capabilities, each with a real generated clip: text and image to video, start and end frames, spoken dialogue, consistent characters, motion transfer, editing and more. Claude wrote every prompt, Higgsfield generated 42 clips, images and sounds (232 credits), every option on the page opens its own example, and HyperFrames cut the showreel and a vertical LinkedIn version in code.

projects.name: Aurelia Hair
projects.blurb: My brand: premium Romanian human hair for US distributors. It includes the website, its own CRM, and a design workspace that turns HTML templates into on-brand posters, social cards and decks.

projects.name: CUTPOINT · The Craft
projects.blurb: A Hebrew-first, vetted community platform for Israeli barbers and beauty professionals, covering safe, certified and responsible hair care.

projects.name: Turbo Studio
projects.blurb: Generates images and short videos from text on your own Mac. It runs SDXL-Turbo and AnimateDiff-Lightning in a native app, and you can drag in an image for inspiration.

projects.name: Terminal First
projects.blurb: A tiny macOS menu-bar app that makes Command–1 always bring up Terminal.

projects.name: Build Ledger
projects.blurb: A one-page ledger for the clinic recorder’s builds. Every build gets a human name — Carpal through Dexterity — with its date, one change score and where it runs, so “which version is live?” never needs a git hash. Notes pin themselves to a build, and a small MCP server lets my agents answer the same question. The live app is Tailscale-only; the public overview shows what’s inside.

projects.name: MCP Registry
projects.blurb: One MCP endpoint for every agent on my tailnet. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes connect to a single URL and get every shared MCP server through it; a server added to the registry reaches all of them within a minute, and a new machine joins with one command. It runs as a small gateway on my Kubernetes cluster and also lists the servers that only run on one machine.

projects.name: Agent Link
projects.blurb: One message bus between my Mac, the Fedora laptop on my monitor and every coding agent on both. Agents talk over MCP, scripts over a small HTTP API, and I work it from a CLI — all reading and writing the same queue. Messages store and forward, so an agent can hand work to a sleeping laptop and it is still there when the lid opens.

projects.name: Screen Pointer
projects.blurb: A visual brief for your coding agent: record a Mac walkthrough, draw a mark, and add timestamped notes while moving between apps. The preview prepares review frames for OpenCode and other MCP agents.

projects.name: Thermal Monitor
projects.blurb: One dashboard for the heat and load of my whole home lab: the MacBook Pro plus all four Ubuntu machines — both Kubernetes nodes and the edge and build boxes. Agents sample temperatures, load, memory, disk, fans and uptime, and a small Rust service stitches them together over Tailscale into a live, dark status page that answers “is anything running hot?” at a glance.

projects.name: Meeting Recorder · מקליט ביקורים
projects.blurb: A visit recorder for a doctor’s clinic. One button starts it. The conversation is transcribed live, the patient is recognised from what is said, and the doctor gets an AI-written clinical summary plus a plain-language letter for the patient.
projects.note: In daily use at a clinic

projects.name: Letter Studio
projects.blurb: A browser studio for the clinic’s patient-letter email: edit the copy, the medication rows and the colours with a live right-to-left preview at desktop and phone widths, then copy the letter JSON into the visit or the design tokens back into the React Email source. It also lays out the four delivery rules the letter must pass — one HTML part, a hosted logo, RTL on every block, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC — with a walkthrough of the pipeline from the studio to the inbox.

projects.name: Naki · נקי
projects.blurb: An air-purifier import business run by an agent. A Hebrew storefront with AI-made product pages, one WhatsApp inbox for my own WhatsApp and the business number, and an agent that drafts every reply, makes the pages and reports to the Fedora laptop. Nothing is sent until I press Send.

projects.name: Third Screen
projects.blurb: A quiet workday agent for the monitor on my right. It picks the music, catches ideas before they disappear, and keeps one calm board of what matters: the next Harvard deadline, three news items worth a glance, one piece of research, one old idea, and the size of my agent fleet. Hermes Agent is the driver; the screen only reflects and never asks. It is built for a two-second glance and switches itself off when I am not working.

projects.name: Noa · נועה
projects.blurb: A phone-first Hebrew voice companion. You send voice notes and she answers in her own voice, remembers what you tell her, and the conversation builds over time.

projects.name: Agent Memory Platform
projects.blurb: A private shared memory service that any AI agent (Codex, Claude Code and others) can use. It stores versioned decisions, project state, tasks and session summaries in Postgres behind an authenticated MCP interface.

projects.name: Claude Telegram Bridge
projects.blurb: Control the Claude Code sessions on my Mac from anywhere by texting a Telegram bot, while the Mac stays at home.

projects.name: WhatsApp MCP
projects.blurb: An MCP server that lets an AI assistant search and read my WhatsApp messages and contacts, including media, and send messages to people or groups.

projects.name: Personal Brand Agent
projects.blurb: A self-hosted agent that scans my GitHub, drafts portfolio updates and LinkedIn posts, and asks for my approval on Telegram before anything is published.

projects.name: AI Office Memory
projects.blurb: A chat-first memory for an interior architect’s office. You ask about any client, project or decision and get the answer with its source.

projects.name: Natural-language → SQL Agent
projects.blurb: Ask a database a question in plain English or Hebrew. The agent turns it into SQL, checks the query is safe, runs it on Postgres and shows the results.

projects.name: Knesset Insights
projects.blurb: Ingests public Knesset committee protocols, organises them, and serves insights about what was said and decided.

projects.name: Land Finder & Land Simulator
projects.blurb: An agent that hunts for affordable rural land (≤ 1 acre, ≤ $10k cash), paired with a 3D map where you pick any patch of ground, see its terrain, rivers and sun direction, draw your area and jump to listings nearby.

projects.name: Data Visualization Agent
projects.blurb: A small LangGraph project that loads a CSV, inspects the data, chooses a suitable chart and generates the visualisation.

projects.name: Israel Air Quality Assistant
projects.blurb: A LangGraph assistant that shows manual tool calling and structured outputs, answering questions about air quality across Israel.

projects.name: Rented-GPU Video Generation
projects.blurb: Rents an RTX 5090 only while it’s generating video and keeps nothing on the rented machine. Finished videos come straight home.

projects.name: Clinic Mail
projects.blurb: Read-only access to the clinic’s Zoho mailboxes as an API, a CLI and an MCP server. Every account, folder, message and raw source sits behind one bearer-token endpoint, so an agent can read the reply to a patient letter — or the bounce that says it never arrived — without touching the mailbox. Fetching uses IMAP BODY.PEEK, so reading never marks mail as read.

projects.name: Bama · במה
projects.blurb: A Hebrew webinar marketplace with three roles (hosts, attendees, moderators) and a moderated lifecycle from submission to live session.

projects.name: Simon Host
projects.blurb: Websites-as-a-service for small businesses: a React + TypeScript front end with a Django lead engine behind it.

projects.name: Rescue Alert System
projects.blurb: An open-source (MIT), real-time, location-based alert system for Malachim Badrachim (מלאכים בדרכים). When an incident happens, the nearest available volunteers are alerted.

projects.name: Kehila Budget Manager
projects.blurb: Budget management for a Chabad community. The rabbi sees every department’s spending at a glance, and each department head gets a focused workspace.

projects.name: ChikChak Learning Academy
projects.blurb: An interactive course site with 9 sequential modules, quizzes, interactive diagrams and a final exam, teaching a team the ChikChak stack.

projects.name: Video Library
projects.blurb: A self-hosted video library in a single Go binary. It lists a media folder and streams with HTTP Range, with the front end embedded.

projects.name: Vivian NFC
projects.blurb: An investor-facing site for a startup making premium NFC collectible cards for celebrities. Fans buy a card at a live event and tap it to unlock exclusive content.

projects.name: Panim · פנים אל פנים
projects.blurb: A Hebrew beta-signup landing page for a video-dating app, built to land its first 50 signups.

projects.name: Systems Consultancy
projects.blurb: My consultancy site for AI and LLM integration, back-end work and delivery.

projects.name: Inner Form
projects.blurb: A Hebrew RTL editorial one-page site for a mind-body coach.

projects.name: Nativ · נתיב
projects.blurb: A Hebrew, phone-first CRM demo built to win an importer as a client. It follows every container from a Chinese factory to the Israeli customer, translates WhatsApp with Chinese suppliers live in both directions, makes payment links in shekels, dollars or euros, and explains how to take international payments in Israel. Tugi, a little tugboat chatbot, shows her around and introduces my work.

projects.name: Mia Dynamics
projects.blurb: A concept redesign demo for an electric tilting-quad vehicle platform.

projects.name: Benny Fluman Consulting
projects.blurb: A Hebrew RTL site for a business consultant, served with Docker and nginx behind a Cloudflare Tunnel.

projects.name: Keygarden
projects.blurb: A touch-typing workout studio with a garden mascot, synthesised key clicks, 20 progressive lessons, timed workouts, streaks, XP and per-key feedback.

projects.name: Life Admin
projects.blurb: A private record vault for one person: documents stored once by hash, facts that must cite the document they came from, deadlines in two jurisdictions, cases, and an audit trail of every read. Rule-based extraction proposes candidates; a human confirms them. Same data reaches an agent through four narrow MCP tools that can search, read and ask for a portal handoff — never file, pay or submit.

projects.name: Way Forward
projects.blurb: A private planning workspace for a legal and financial situation: the known debts, the questions that decide what actually blocks a departure, and a budget calculator for testing a realistic monthly payment. Entries stay in the browser instead of on the server, and the same calculations ship as a small CLI and a stateless MCP server.

projects.name: My First Real Quantum Computing Project
projects.ledgerName: My First Real Quantum Computing Project
projects.blurb: A beginner-friendly project on sending quantum circuits from ordinary software to real quantum hardware, built around Shor’s algorithm.

projects.name: Coffee Punch Card
projects.blurb: A simple loyalty app that gives a free cup after nine purchases. I made it as a gift for a coffee shop I loved.

projects.name: Home Kubernetes Cloud
projects.blurb: My own small cloud on four mini-PCs, linked by Tailscale and exposed through Cloudflare Tunnels. Most of the apps on this page run here.

projects.name: Early projects
projects.blurb: Where it started: an A* pathfinding visualiser, a Sudoku solver, a two-player space shooter, a COVID-19 voice assistant built on web scraping, and a business card in Flutter.
